items.title: A passenger ferry capsized off the coast of northern Cyprus on Sunday, shortly after leaving port, the local government said. Six people have died, Turkish state media reported, citing Unal Ustel, prime minister of the self-proclaimed Turkish Republic of Norther
alsoAt: ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
